"Dassanahetuttika, Hetuduka" (Patthana 16.33) is an Abhidhamma text located within the Paṭṭhāna, the seventh and final treatise of the Pali Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Structurally, the text treats the intersection of the *dassanahetuttika* (the triad concerning states having root conditions abandoned by vision) and the *hetuduka* (the dyad of root conditions), analyzing their interrelations within the standard causal framework of the Paṭṭhāna.
